# test/helpers

`test/helpers` implements integration test infrastructure via `capture.ts` and `temp-repo.ts`. `runCLI` executes `src/cli.ts` using `spawnSync`, returning `CapturedOutput`. `createTempRepo` initializes git environments with `user.email=test@git-lanes.dev`, managed by `withTempRepo` RAII wrapper.

## Contents

- [capture.ts](./capture.ts) — Exports `runCLI`, `CapturedOutput`.
- [temp-repo.ts](./temp-repo.ts) — Exports `createTempRepo`, `removeTempRepo`, `withTempRepo`, `addFileAndCommit`.

## Patterns

`withTempRepo` ensures `removeTempRepo` execution in `finally` block. `spawnSync` wraps git commands with `cwd` set to repo path.

## Behavioral Contracts

`CLI_PATH` resolves to `src/cli.ts`. Git config uses `user.email=test@git-lanes.dev` and `user.name=Test User`. `rmSync` uses `{ recursive: true, force: true }`.

## Stack

Requires `Bun` runtime for `spawnSync`. Uses `mkdirSync`, `writeFileSync`, `rmSync` from Node `fs`, `tmpdir` from `os`.
